svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 11/12 Valley Sunset (Common)
svg.desc: Nothing in the way for miles. The sky gets the whole show and the sun takes its time going down. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
